ground_truth.description: When a session call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails, the transaction reverts but nonce is not consumed. The signature remains valid and can be replayed for partial calls. Session signatures are validated per-call using individual call hashes, enabling partial replay. Frontrunners can execute subsets of calls to grief or cause financial loss.
ground_truth.root_cause: When a session call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails, the transaction reverts but nonce is not consumed. The signature remains valid and can be replayed for partial calls. Session signatures are validated per-call using individual call hashes, enabling partial replay. Frontrunners can execute subsets of calls to grief or cause financial loss.
ground_truth.attack_scenario: Original payload: Calls [A, B, C] with signatures [SigA, SigB, SigC]. Execution: [A succeed, B succeed, C revert]. Result: Revert, nonce unused. Attack: Replay [A, B] with [SigA, SigB]. PoC: File POC.t.sol with test testSubmissionValidity. It builds a 2-call payload, expects revert on second call, then replays partial payload successfully.
ground_truth.fix_description: Bind session call signatures to the complete payload hash to prevent partial signature replay.

vulnerabilities.explanation: The contract validates signatures per individual call rather than binding them to the complete payload hash. When a call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails, the transaction reverts but the nonce is not consumed, leaving signatures valid for partial replay.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. User signs payload with calls [A, B, C] and signatures [SigA, SigB, SigC]. 2. Call B fails with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR, causing full transaction revert. 3. Frontrunner observes failed transaction and extracts valid signatures. 4. Frontrunner executes subset [A, C] using same signatures, bypassing intended execution order and potentially causing financial loss.
vulnerabilities.suggested_fix: Bind session call signatures to the complete payload hash (hash of all calls together) rather than validating per individual call. Ensure nonce is consumed before signature validation or implement atomic execution where all signatures become invalid after any failure.

prediction.overall_explanation: The contract contains a critical signature replay vulnerability where partial execution of signed calls is possible after failures. The nonce consumption occurs before signature validation, but when transactions revert due to BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR, the nonce consumption is rolled back while signatures remain valid for individual calls, enabling frontrunning attacks.
